description: Run a query against a datasource through Grafana's unified query API and return the result frames. For Prometheus/Loki set `expr` (PromQL / LogQL); for SQL datasources set `rawSql`. Reading data only — this never mutates anything. Use a bounded time range and a small maxDataPoints to keep results manageable.

expr.description: PromQL or LogQL expression, e.g. 'up' or 'rate(http_requests_total[5m])'.

from.description: Range start, e.g. 'now-1h' or an epoch ms string. Default now-1h.

rawSql.description: SQL for SQL datasources (a single read-only SELECT).

name: query_datasource
title: Query a datasource
